title: Bobby Prince, composer for Doom, Wolfenstein 3D, and Duke Nukem 3D, has died
summary: Announcement of the death of Bobby Prince, the legendary video game composer who created iconic music for DOOM, Wolfenstein 3D, and Duke Nukem 3D - games that defined the FPS genre and DOS-era gaming.
problem_solved: Not applicable - this is a news obituary, not a technical project.
why_valuable: Marks the passing of a pivotal figure in video game music history whose compositions defined the atmosphere of classic 90s FPS games.
